subject: Decision: July plan for video-in-the-wild depth
body:
Team,

Outcomes from the June 15 baseline review, plus July commitments:

1. Baseline quality is good enough to proceed: with the dilation+confidence masking fix, depth error on uncalibrated clips is within 9% of the calibrated-camera baseline. That gap is the whole story for the LRB.
2. The learned-intrinsics ablation is confirmed as the July centerpiece per Alina's staffing plan. Deliverable: a camera-type breakdown (phone, dashcam, action cam) of learned vs. specified intrinsics by July 8.
3. Scope cut: no real-time serving demo this half. Wanjiru's latency numbers say we would need a distilled model, and I would rather show honest offline quality than a laggy demo.

LRB readout targeted for July 9.

Lucia
